environment_takeout.reach_ranking: Roadside has the highest weekly reach in the Q2 2026 data at 53.2 million, followed by Bus Exterior at 48.9 million.
environment_takeout.impacts_ranking: The environments generating the highest numbers of weekly impacts are Roadside (5.6bn), London Underground (3.2bn), Shopping Centre Interior (1.9bn), Rail Station (1.3bn) and Bus Exterior (1.1bn).

region_takeout.outside_london: Outside London, the Midlands and North West each generate approximately 1.2 billion weekly impacts. The South & South-East has the highest weekly reach outside London at 9.9 million, followed by the Midlands at 9.3 million and the North West at 7.0 million.
